categories.name: Other words for a festive event

fun_fact: Festivals are a great way to bring people together. And that's what the next week promises to be for people who care about climate in India: Climate Week India is happening from Sept 27 - Oct 4. Not one summit in one city. Hundreds of gatherings, walks, screenings, clean-ups and conversations, hosted by communities across India, in the languages India speaks. [Check it out!](https://climateweek.in/)
author: Sailee
